hypothesis: In resolve_google_maps_placelist, using raw_text.lstrip(")]}'\n") treats the argument as a character set rather than a prefix string. If raw_text contains an empty list like )]}'\n[], lstrip strips the left bracket or delimiter, causing JSONDecodeError instead of safe JSON parsing.

In resolve_google_maps_placelist, executing a single-shot unretried HTTP call to preview/entitylist/getlist causes transient Google Maps edge CDN cold-cache, challenge, or empty-item responses to fail immediately without retry, resulting in false-negative 422 errors.

In poi_resolve_link, head_resp timeout is 8.0s while placelist RPC timeout is 12.0s. If short-link redirect takes >8s, head_resp times out and is caught, leaving is_placelist=False and erroneously routing the placelist into single-POI resolver which fails with 422.
